item.title: Arts Education and Access Fund
item.description: Collections lag, administrative overhead is structurally high, and the Council periodically authorizes carve-outs to "support arts ecosystem" outside the schools-and-grants frame.

item.title: Portland Clean Energy Community Benefits Fund
item.description: Collections vastly outran original projections; the Council subsequently authorized broader uses including general transportation, parks, and sewer maintenance — items not contemplated in the ballot text.

item.title: Housing Investment Fund (TIF Set-Aside)
item.description: Set-aside percentages have been honored in headline reporting but partially offset by reclassifying eligible projects, swapping districts, and converting "obligations" into deferred allocations.

item.title: Rental Services / Tenant Protections Fund
item.description: Fee revenue is routinely under-deployed against the program lines it was created for; balances have been periodically swept toward general housing administration.

item.title: Metro Affordable Housing Bond
item.description: Unit counts have been adjusted downward relative to original targets; per-unit costs have grown well above the projection range; "preserved" vs "built" classification has shifted to maintain headline numbers.

item.title: Preschool For All
item.description: Collections sharply outran ramp-up capacity, producing a multi-hundred-million accumulated balance even as enrollment lagged the implementation plan.

item.title: Supportive Housing Services Measure
item.description: Counties have collected far more than they could disburse against contracted capacity; carryover balances are being reframed as "long-term reserves" without clear voter mandate.
